content.short: Meeds tokenizes engagement and fairly values daily, unseen efforts, with on-chain rewards to build an on-chain reputation.
content.description: Meeds addresses the global work disengagement crisis by tokenizing engagement and fairly valuing daily, invisible efforts as well as the extra miles teammates go. It enables DAOs or traditional organizations to gather contributors on dedicated work hubs, where participation can be tracked and incentives can be offered transparently. Rewards and recognition are issued on-chain, helping to build an on-chain reputation for contributors and align incentives with meaningful impact.
content.meta: Meeds focuses on building a decentralized engagement platform for the future of work. Discover Meeds and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
